title: Deep neural network detects atrial fibrillation and flutter in long-term ambulatory ECG
summary: A deep neural network detected AF and atrial flutter in long-term ambulatory ECGs and, on a separate expert-annotated test set of 1,039 recordings (1,010 patients), reached time-level sensitivity of 96.4% with specificity above 99.99%. At recording level, sensitivity was 100% and specificity 98.77% (11 of 897 false positives). The study is retrospective, with a single-hospital test set.
ai_technology: Deep neural network detecting atrial fibrillation and flutter in ambulatory ECG recordings
organization: University of Eastern Finland; Kuopio University Hospital
